title: Quarry Bank Scarecrow Festival
venue: Quarry Bank, Styal, Wilmslow, Cheshire
cost: Free event with normal admission; optional scarecrow trail £2.50
description: Quarry Bank's autumn festival runs daily from 10:30am to 5pm with a scarecrow trail, storytelling, crafts, games and indoor and outdoor family activities. Event activities are free with normal property admission; the outdoor scarecrow trail costs £2.50 extra.

title: Grimmfest 2026
venue: ODEON Great Northern, Manchester
description: Manchester's international festival of fantastic film runs for four days with horror, thrillers, sci-fi and dark comedy, plus Q&As, signings and a weekend market. Day and weekend passes are sold out; individual screening tickets remain the useful route.

title: Storytime at Cheadle Library
venue: Cheadle Library, 23 Ashfield Road, Cheadle, Stockport SK8 1BB
description: A relaxed story and rhyme session for pre-school children with parents or carers, listed for Thursday afternoon at Cheadle Library.

title: Digital support drop-in at Cheadle Library
venue: Cheadle Library, 23 Ashfield Road, Cheadle SK8 1BB
description: A free one-hour drop-in for beginners who want help with devices or getting things done online. No booking is required.

title: Babalola at Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club
venue: Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AT
description: Soul and Motown singer Babalola performs on Saturday evening at Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club.

title: Ben Nuttall's Footy Factory
venue: Stockroom, Merseyway Shopping Centre, Stockport SK1 1PW
description: Football freestyler Ben Nuttall combines stories from his book with step-by-step demonstrations of matchday tricks. Suitable for ages 7+.

title: Bramhall Halloween Event & Market
venue: Bramhall Village Square, Bramhall SK7 1AW
description: Worker Bee Markets brings up to 50 makers and traders to Bramhall Village Square, with seasonal treats, handmade decorations, gifts and Halloween bits. Runs 10am–3pm.

title: Create at Staircase: Beaded spiders
venue: Staircase House, 30/31 Market Place, Stockport SK1 1ES
description: An adults-only Halloween craft session led by artist Caroline Coates, making beaded spiders with simple jewellery techniques. All materials are provided. Ages 16+.

title: Dementia Disco
venue: Ladybridge Residents Club, Edenbridge Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5PX
description: A warm, music-led social event intended to prompt memories, conversation and friendship for people affected by dementia and those close to them.

title: Meet the Quakers at Cheadle Hulme Meeting House
venue: Cheadle Hulme Quaker Meeting House, 91 Station Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 7BG
description: An open afternoon for attenders and people curious about what Quakers do. Arrive from 1:30pm for a 1:45pm start; the afternoon runs until 4pm. Families bringing children are asked to contact the organiser in advance.

title: Professional wrestling at Stockport Plaza
venue: The Plaza, Mersey Square, Stockport SK1 1SP
description: Professional wrestling returns to The Plaza for a family-oriented evening of British wrestling talent. The advertised card is subject to change.

title: Reddish Vale Halloween Pumpkin Festival
venue: Reddish Vale Farm, Stockport
description: Pumpkin patch, carving cavern, wand-making, games, magic, roaming characters, farm activities, indoor play and a nature trail. The organiser's live booking basket is the safest place to check the current total price and extras.

title: Stockport Makers Market
venue: Market Place, Stockport SK1 1ES
description: Around 70 maker stalls with artisan food, handmade goods, art, design and vintage in Stockport's Market Place, running 10am to 4pm.

title: Stockport Symphony Orchestra: The Italian One
venue: Stockport Town Hall, Edward Street, Stockport SK1 3XE
cost: £16 adult · £14 concession · £5 student under 21 · accompanied under-16s free
description: The season opener includes Mascagni, Tchaikovsky, Shostakovich, Verdi and Respighi, conducted by Robert Guy.

title: Storytime at Heald Green Library
venue: Heald Green Library, Finney Lane, Heald Green, Stockport SK8 3JB
description: A weekly story and rhyme session for pre-school children with parents or carers at Heald Green Library.

title: Free pregnancy social at Brezo Lounge
venue: Brezo Lounge, 30 High Street, Cheadle
description: An informal social for expectant parents, hosted by Birth Baby & You. Runs 11am–12:30pm. Booking is required; one booking covers the expectant mum plus one birth partner or friend.

title: Exhibition Launch: SUBTEXT
venue: Stockroom, Merseyway Shopping Centre, Stockport SK1 1PR
description: Free launch evening for Stockroom's SUBTEXT exhibition, featuring newly commissioned work by Parham Ghalamdar co-produced with people in Stockport. Runs 5pm–7pm.

title: Third Friday Flea
venue: St Mary's Church Halls, South Reddish, Stockport SK5 7AX
description: An evening flea market with stalls spanning mid-century and modern collectables, skincare, clothing and other finds.

title: Saturday Snack Down: Halloween Spooktacular
venue: Stall 3 Market Hall, Market Place, Stockport SK1 1EW
description: A Halloween edition of Stockport Market's family-friendly Saturday Snack Down, running noon to 5pm. No tickets are required.

title: The Girl on the Train at Chads Theatre
venue: Chads Theatre, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AU
description: Chads Theatre stages the psychological thriller adapted from Paula Hawkins' novel and the DreamWorks film. There is also a 2.30pm matinee on Saturday 24 October.

title: Alicia's Amazing Adventure to Find the First Black Britons
venue: Stockroom, Merseyway Shopping Centre, Stockport SK1 1PR
description: A family theatre show for ages 7+ using time travel, history and storytelling to explore the first Black Britons, identity and belonging.

title: The Witch's Potion Trail at Bramall Hall
venue: Bramall Hall, Hall Road, Bramhall, Stockport SK7 3NX
cost: £3 per child trail + accompanying adult admission
description: A Halloween hunt through Bramall Hall for children aged 3+, searching the rooms for Batilda the witch's scattered potion ingredients. Advance booking is recommended because sessions can sell out.

title: Iconic drag show
venue: Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AT
description: A live-singing drag tribute show built around songs from different music icons across the decades.

title: Stockport Dads Club: October Half Term
venue: Stockroom, Merseyway Shopping Centre, Stockport SK1 1PR
cost: Free general event; under-2 sensory session £2
description: Half-term day for dads and father figures with children, including story time, den building, Lego, board games and table football. The under-2 sensory session costs £2 and includes a hot drink and barm.

title: Wallace & Gromit: A Grand Day Out
venue: Jodrell Bank, Cheshire
description: Special Space Dome screenings of A Grand Day Out with the soundtrack performed live, plus optional model-making. Sunday includes a dedicated relaxed SEN performance.

title: BSL Signed Storytime
venue: Stockroom Studios, Merseyway Shopping Centre, Stockport SK1 1PR
description: Inclusive British Sign Language signed storytime for under-5s and families, delivered with the National Deaf Children's Society. Particularly suitable for children who are deaf, have hearing loss or additional communication needs.

title: October half term at Jodrell Bank
venue: Jodrell Bank, Cheshire
description: A half-term programme with a Curious Kids science show, Space Dome films, telescope activities and The North Revisited exhibition. Book general admission in advance for guaranteed entry.

title: Foodie Friday
venue: Market Place, Stockport SK1 1EW
description: Street food, craft ales and live music at Stockport Market Place from 6pm to 9pm. Food and drink cost extra.

title: Arc Saturday Art Club
venue: Arc at Hat Works, Wellington Road South, Stockport SK3 0EU
description: A family drop-in art club at Arc at Hat Works from 11am to 3pm, with activities designed for adults and children aged 3+. No booking is needed; a £3 charitable donation per artist is suggested for those who can afford it.

title: Halloween Crafty Kids Pop Up
venue: Heald Green Library, Finney Lane, Heald Green, Cheadle SK8 3JB
description: A Halloween drop-in craft session for children of all ages at Heald Green Library, designed for hands-on making and imagination.

title: North Room live at Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club
venue: Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AT
description: Local band North Room play a Saturday-night set at Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, with the venue describing a wide range of music and free entry.

venue: Jodrell Bank, Bomish Lane, Lower Withington, Macclesfield SK11 9DW
description: UNE, the electronic dream-pop and ambient duo of Mark Radcliffe and Paul Langley, perform inside Jodrell Bank's Space Dome with full-dome visuals and a space conversation with Professor Tim O'Brien. Doors open at 7pm and the event runs 7:30pm to 10pm.
